profile.Name: Digna
profile.Personality: She feels hollow after killing her father and is frightened by her own lack of feeling. Polite and quick to apologize, she turns cutting toward anyone tied to her old life, such as the former sentinel Griffin.
profile.Backstory: She grew up in Stack in the Holy Nation. When her father stopped her from running away, she killed him and fled to Flotsam Village, where she has spent about a month. Nightmares about her father keep her from sleeping, and she wants to get far away from both the Holy Nation and Flotsam.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Speaks haltingly and trails off when she talks about her past. Still swears by Okran, and turns dry and sarcastic when needled.
